mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_setting (setting_key, setting_value, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{settingKey}, #{settingValue}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_setting SET setting_value = #{settingValue}, description = #{description}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE setting_key = #{settingKey}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_setting WHERE setting_key = #{settingKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_setting WHERE setting_key = #{settingKey}
